title: Autonomous Company Runtime / Founder Spectator Mode
northStar: AI operates the company continuously; founder observes and intervenes only by choice or at irreversible approval gates.

missions.name: Control Surface Reset
missions.outcome: Clean repository authority surface, one obvious history landing zone, generic mission selection and autonomy north star.
missions.proof: root <=10 markdown; generic registry/CLI; no product/data changes

missions.name: Company Brain & Durable Mission Governor
missions.outcome: Persistent mission state, generic create/plan/resume/next/close flows, dependency graph and crash-safe continuation.
missions.proof: interrupt and resume a mission without chat memory

missions.name: AI Executive Council
missions.outcome: CEO, Chief of Staff, CTO/Architect, CPO/User Advocate and Critic produce structured competing recommendations and a decision record instead of one-model first-thought planning.
missions.proof: decision includes alternatives, dissent, evidence and decision class

missions.name: Autonomous Environment & Toolchain Manager
missions.outcome: AI restores dependencies, starts app/preview, provisions or selects disposable QA resources, validates secrets/preconditions, runs browser tests and cleans up.
missions.proof: B6 runtime blockers can be resolved without founder relay when credentials/resources exist

missions.name: Self-Healing Engineering Swarm
missions.outcome: Mission decomposition, bounded parallel builders, failure classification, targeted repair and conflict-aware integration.
missions.proof: injected defects are diagnosed/repaired within budget without scope drift

missions.name: Autonomous User, Pilot & Product Critic
missions.outcome: AI acts as realistic users/admins/chairmen/presidents, explores journeys, detects friction and generates evidence-backed opportunities before coding.
missions.proof: user-simulation findings reproduce in browser evidence and feed ranked missions

missions.name: Independent Risk & Review Board
missions.outcome: Separate-context adversarial architecture/security/data/UX/performance review with blocking severity and candidate binding.
missions.proof: builder cannot self-approve; seeded violations are caught

missions.name: Autonomous Release, Rollback & Incident Loop
missions.outcome: Preview, migration plan, deploy checks, smoke verification, rollback decision and incident triage become executable workflows.
missions.proof: safe rehearsal from candidate to preview and rollback with complete evidence

missions.name: Company Memory & Learning Engine
missions.outcome: Decisions, failures, user evidence, metrics and mission outcomes become durable knowledge used by future planning rather than repeated context loading.
missions.proof: new mission automatically cites and applies relevant prior lessons

missions.name: Founder Spectator Cockpit
missions.outcome: One dashboard shows executive debate, active missions, decisions, risk, evidence, autonomy score, interventions and next moves.
missions.proof: founder can understand/control company without reading logs or raw markdown

missions.name: Zero-Touch Mission Demonstration
missions.outcome: One substantial product/architecture objective executes end-to-end from intent to release-ready candidate.
missions.proof: zero manual error relay; <=1 optional founder intervention; independent review and runtime proof

missions.name: Continuous Autonomous Portfolio Loop
missions.outcome: AI observes product/engineering evidence, selects the next highest-value bounded mission and continues within budget/authority without requiring a new prompt each cycle.
missions.proof: multiple sequential missions are selected and completed from evidence with founder summary-only interaction
